preparation.base: C++ toolchain (`clang++`/`g++`, `make`, `autoconf`, `automake`, `libtool`, `cmake`, `zlib`, `bzip2`, `liblzma`, `libcurl`, `openssl`), compiled from unmodified upstream v1.2 `Makefile`
preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification failed during installation (`cmd_not_found: autoreconf`) because `README.md` only lists `gcc`, `cmake`, `googletest`, and `zlib` before running `make`, omitting `autoconf`/`automake`/`libtool` and the HTSlib development headers (`libbz2-dev`, `liblzma-dev`, `libcurl4-openssl-dev`, `libssl-dev`) required by `Makefile` (line 91). In addition, `Makefile` (line 96) clones `spoa` over SSH (`git@github.com:rvaser/spoa.git`), which fails in clean environments without GitHub SSH keys.
steps: # Option B (compile unmodified v1.2 from source on Ubuntu/Debian; run make sequentially without -j):
apt-get install -y build-essential git autoconf automake libtool cmake zlib1g-dev libbz2-dev liblzma-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev

recommendations: Document the full Ubuntu/Debian build dependencies in `README.md` (`autoconf`, `automake`, `libtool`, `zlib1g-dev`, `libbz2-dev`, `liblzma-dev`, `libcurl4-openssl-dev`, `libssl-dev`) as a single copyable `apt-get install` block before `make`, and/or document the official Bioconda package (`conda install -c bioconda longtr=1.2`).

Replace the SSH clone URLs in `Makefile` (line 96: `git@github.com:rvaser/spoa.git`) and `README.md` (line 20: `git@github.com:gymrek-lab/LongTR.git`) with HTTPS URLs (`https://github.com/...`) so clean builds succeed without GitHub SSH keys.
Add explicit target dependencies in `Makefile` (making object files and `LongTR` wait for `HTSLIB-docker` and `SPOA-docker`) so parallel builds (`make -j`) do not race ahead of `htslib` and `spoa`.

Pass `-DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` (or update `spoa`/`googletest`) in `Makefile` (line 108) for CMake 4.x compatibility, and regenerate `src/version.cpp` on tagged releases (`--version` currently prints `638942f-dirty` on `v1.2`).

verdict.title: Runs in manual verification
verdict.reason: Compiled unmodified upstream LongTR v1.2 (`2be6cf5`) sequentially with `make` after provisioning autotools, CMake, and the required HTSlib development headers (`CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` for CMake 4 compatibility with `spoa`'s bundled `googletest`, zero source modifications). Executed the documented `LongTR` command from `README.md` (lines 35-39, using `--phased-bam`) against the 1000 Genomes ONT R10 SUP `hg38` CODIS reference slice (`ont-bam-hg38`, `HG00113`). Execution completed in under 3 seconds (exit 0), producing `tr_calls.vcf.gz` with 20/20 called forensic autosomal CODIS STR loci (626 total reads in `FORMAT/DP`, depth 21 to 44 per locus, max 44 at `D19S433`).

summary.why: Automated verification failed to compile because `README.md` omits `autoconf` (`autoreconf`) and HTSlib development libraries required by `Makefile`, and `Makefile` clones `spoa` over SSH. conclusion.title: Repeatability of this manual run
conclusion.body: The pinned upstream commit, prepared environment description, exact commands executed, and sanitized terminal output recorded in this report document the procedure for independent reproduction.

limitations: Results apply exclusively to the exact Git commit SHA and manually prepared environment recorded in this report.
Single regional reference slice per input type; low-coverage warnings on sliced BAMs do not imply defects on whole-genome data.
Plausible Output checks verify structural format and recognizable STR loci, not biological genotype truth.
Verification is a point-in-time snapshot; upstream repository changes after this commit are not covered until re-verification.
No truth-set concordance, forensic casework validation, or regulatory compliance assessment was performed.

es.plain_why: La verificación automática falló al compilar porque `README.md` omite `autoconf` (`autoreconf`) y las librerías de desarrollo de HTSlib requeridas por `Makefile`, y `Makefile` clona `spoa` por SSH. En verificación manual, tras preparar esos prerrequisitos de compilación y compilar LongTR v1.2 sin modificar desde código fuente (sin editar una sola línea), LongTR corrió de principio a fin sobre el recorte ONT R10 SUP de 1000 Genomes y genotipó los 20/20 loci STR CODIS forenses (ver Sección 4 para los pasos exactos).
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática falló durante la instalación (`cmd_not_found: autoreconf`) porque `README.md` solo lista `gcc`, `cmake`, `googletest` y `zlib` antes de ejecutar `make`, omitiendo `autoconf`/`automake`/`libtool` y las cabeceras de desarrollo de HTSlib (`libbz2-dev`, `liblzma-dev`, `libcurl4-openssl-dev`, `libssl-dev`) requeridas por `Makefile` (línea 91). Además, `Makefile` (línea 96) clona `spoa` por SSH (`git@github.com:rvaser/spoa.git`), lo que falla en entornos limpios sin claves SSH de GitHub.
es.reason: Se compiló LongTR v1.2 original sin modificar (`2be6cf5`) de forma secuencial con `make` tras preparar autotools, CMake y las cabeceras de desarrollo de HTSlib (`CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` para compatibilidad de CMake 4 con el `googletest` incluido en `spoa`, cero modificaciones al código). Se ejecutó el comando documentado de `LongTR` en `README.md` (líneas 35-39, con `--phased-bam`) sobre el recorte de referencia ONT R10 SUP `hg38` de 1000 Genomes (`ont-bam-hg38`, `HG00113`). La ejecución finalizó en menos de 3 segundos (exit 0), generando `tr_calls.vcf.gz` con los 20/20 loci STR CODIS autosómicos genotipados (626 lecturas totales en `FORMAT/DP`, profundidad de 21 a 44 por locus, máximo 44 en `D19S433`).

Pasar `-DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` (o actualizar `spoa`/`googletest`) en `Makefile` (línea 108) para compatibilidad con CMake 4.x, y regenerar `src/version.cpp` en cada release etiquetado (`--version` actualmente imprime `638942f-dirty` en `v1.2`).
